title: Bug Ledger Admin — the same bug across apps and analyses

tasks.text: Check for an existing admin + map every data source
tasks.note: No admin exists. Six sources mapped: bugs.json 428 (26 apps), harvested 275, scan-findings 99, D1 submitted 200 (17 apps), 64 check-logs with 312 found items, scan stories. Exact titles never repeat across apps — clustering must be by detector id + fuzzy title
GET /api/admin/recurrence live (401 without key): gathers catalogue, harvested, scanner, submitted, all check-logs and all story findings + the analyses list; re-read every minute by the page
Admin page live at /admin: 1,607 instances → 1,168 bug classes in 31 ms; 64 classes in 2+ apps, 28 in 3+; five views + export; found and fixed a prototype-key crash in its own clustering (ledgered)
Classes, heatmap, by-analysis, over-time, gate all rendered and screenshotted from real API data; the token was never typed into a web form
